provenance.notes: Medical triage and sanitation references are educational and do not replace professional medical diagnosis, surgery, or care.

sanitation.maintenance: Cover waste with carbon (peat moss/sawdust) after use. Empty bucket every 1-2 weeks.
sanitation.risk: Medium (improper carbon ratio leads to fly breeding and odor)
sanitation.cold: Bacterial activity drops below 55°F; acts as holding chamber in winter.

sanitation.maintenance: Line 5-gal bucket with heavy contractor bag. Cover with sawdust/kitty litter. Tie off.
sanitation.risk: High (spillage, pathogen exposure when handling full bags)
sanitation.cold: Will freeze if left in unheated outbuildings.

sanitation.maintenance: Dig 4-6 ft pit. Build structure over it. Throw lime or ash down regularly to suppress smells.
sanitation.risk: High (water table contamination if dug too close to wells/springs)
sanitation.cold: Fully operational in cold weather; freezing wind can be uncomfortable.

sanitation.useCase: Standard homestead permits, high water flow
sanitation.maintenance: Pump tank every 3-5 years. Avoid flushing grease, chemicals, or plastics.
sanitation.risk: Low (if installed by code; high cost to replace failed leach field)
sanitation.cold: Requires pipes buried below local frost depth to prevent freeze blockages.

hygiene.desc: Setup a 'tippy-tap' gravity bottle filled with water, activated by a foot pedal string. Keep soap suspended in a mesh bag to dry.
Use a 3-basin system. Basin 1: Scrape & wash (hot soapy water). Basin 2: Rinse (clean warm water). Basin 3: Sanitize (cool water with 1 capful of bleach). Air dry only.
Agitate clothes in a clean 5-gallon bucket using a clean plunger (with holes cut in the rubber cone). Wring out using a manual hand wringer.
Store all food in steel canisters. Set snap traps along wall bases. Keep compost piles at least 50 feet away from living quarters.

firstAidTriage.action: Apply direct pressure with sterile gauze. If bleeding doesn't stop and is arterial (spurting), apply a tourniquet high and tight on the limb. Record application time.

firstAidTriage.desc: Verify breathing. If unconscious, perform head-tilt chin-lift. Check for obstruction. Start CPR if pulse is absent.

firstAidTriage.action: Cool burn immediately with cool running water for 10-20 mins. Do NOT apply grease, butter, or ice. Cover loosely with sterile non-stick dressing.
Remove wet clothes. Wrap patient in dry blankets (cover head but not face). Share body heat if possible. Give warm, sweet liquids ONLY if fully conscious.
Watch for: expanding red streaks from wound, hot skin, high fever, or confusion. Requires immediate medical attention.
